title: CommandLifecycleEvent
description: What happened to one robot command after the server accepted it: ACCEPTED (the server owns it), RUNNING (the controller has it), COMPLETED, FAILED or CANCELLED. The events of one command share its operation_id (the id of the Operation that carries it) and grow by sequence. FAILED and CANCELLED say why. The schema is closed.

operation_id.description: The Operation that carries the command.

robot_id.description: The robot the command was sent to, as the server names it.

command.description: The verb of the command, for example move or stop.

state.description: Where the command is. COMPLETED only with evidence that the controller carried it out.

at_utc.description: When the command reached this state.

sequence.description: Grows with every event of one command; a consumer ignores an event older than the last one it saw.

reason.description: Why the command failed or was cancelled; required for FAILED and CANCELLED.
